text.alreadyLinked: This chat is already linked to an account.
text.appsIntro: Pick an app — I will send the install link and the one that connects it.
text.appsManual: This app cannot add a subscription by itself — copy the link and paste it in:
text.autoRenewNeedsCard: Add a card on the site first — there is nothing to renew with.
text.autoRenewOff: Auto-renewal is off. Access ends on {date} and nothing is charged.
text.autoRenewOn: Auto-renewal is on. The next period is charged automatically.
text.chargeFailed:
We could not charge your card ❌

Access runs until {date}. Pay with the "Subscribe" button or add another card.
text.checkoutIntro: Pay at the link below. Access opens the moment the payment clears:
text.choosePlan: Pick a term. The longer it runs, the cheaper the month:
text.codeInvalid:
That code did not work — it is unknown, already used or expired.

Get a new one on the site: the Telegram tab.
text.deleteAsk: Delete this account? The subscription ends with no refund for the remaining period, every device disconnects and the link stops working. We cannot bring it back.
text.deleted: The account is gone. Thanks for being with us.
text.devicesAdded:
Devices added ✅

The new limit shows under "Subscription". Your existing link keeps working.
text.devicesIntro: Pay at the link below. The limit rises the moment it clears:
text.devicesMax: You are at the limit — no more devices can be added.
text.devicesNow: Devices now: {count}. Each extra one is a one-off {price} RUB.
text.expired:
Your subscription has ended.

Access is off. Press "Subscribe" to start again.
text.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
text.help:
The buttons below do everything the commands do:

🚀 Connect — your link for the app
📱 Apps — the apps that take it, and where to get them
📊 Subscription — expiry and devices
💳 Subscribe or Renew — pay for access
🎁 Free day — twenty-four hours, on us
➕ Devices — add simultaneous connections
🔄 Auto-charge — turn charging on or off
🔁 New link — when the old one reached the wrong hands
🌐 Website — a one-time link into your account
🌍 Language — switch language
🔌 Unlink — disconnect this chat from your account
🗑️ Delete — remove the account and its subscription

Something broken? Write to support on the site.
text.inactive:
No active subscription.

Press Subscribe to turn your access back on.
text.linkIntro: Your subscription URL. Copy it and add it to the app:
text.linkWarning: Do not forward this link: it is the credential to your subscription. If it leaks, rotate it on the site.
text.linked:
Done — this chat is linked to your account.

Everything is here now, on the buttons below.
text.noSubscription:
No subscription yet.

Press Free day to try it, or Subscribe to start right away.
text.notLinked:
This chat is not linked to an account.

Open the Telegram tab on the site, press Connect Telegram, and send the code here.
text.paid:
Payment received ✅

Your subscription is active until {date}.

Press "Connect" for your link.
text.renewed:
Subscription renewed automatically ✅

{amount} ₽ charged, active until {date}.

Turn this off with the "Auto-charge" button.
text.rotateAsk: Get a new link? The old one stops working and has to be re-added to every app.
text.rotateDone: Your link is new. The old one no longer works — add this one to your app:
text.start:
GnomeVPN — a fast VPN with no speed limits.

YouTube in 4K, social media, games. Works on iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS and TVs.

Your account was created just now, from this chat — nothing to fill in and nothing to confirm. Start with the free day or subscribe using the buttons below.

The same account opens on {site} — the "Website" button sends a link that signs you in.
text.trialEnds: When the free day ends, subscribe to keep your access.
text.trialGranted:
Your free day is live 🎁

Press Connect to get your link.
text.trialNeedsEmail: Confirm your email address on the site first — the message is already on its way to the address on your account.
text.trialUnavailable:
The free day has already been used — it is given once.

Press Subscribe to get a subscription.
text.unlinkAsk: Unlink this chat? Your subscription and access stay — you will still be able to sign in with your email.
text.unlinkNoEmail:
This account was created in Telegram and there is no other way into it yet. Unlink now and the subscription stays, but nothing can open it.

Add an email in your account first and set a password through "Forgot password?" — after that, unlinking is safe.
text.unlinked: Chat unlinked. Your subscription and access are untouched — you can come back any time.
text.websiteIntro: Here is your sign-in link. It works once and lasts 10 minutes — do not forward it to anyone.
